# tdlib-android

Precompiled TDLib for Android — all 4 ABIs, built by CI, distributed as AARs via GitHub Releases and Maven Central.

- Repo: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/tdlib-android
- Releases: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/tdlib-android/releases
- Maven: io.github.tdlib-android:core / io.github.tdlib-android:ktx
- Current version: 1.8.64
- ABIs: arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, x86
- License: BSL-1.0 (core) / Apache-2.0 (ktx)

## Install

```kotlin
// settings.gradle.kts
dependencyResolutionManagement { repositories { google(); mavenCentral() } }

// app/build.gradle.kts
dependencies {
  implementation("io.github.tdlib-android:core:1.8.64")
  implementation("io.github.tdlib-android:ktx:1.8.64")
}
```

## Usage

```kotlin
System.loadLibrary("tdjni")
val client = TdClient(filesDir = context.filesDir.absolutePath + "/tdlib")
client.init()
CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
  client.updates.collect { update -> /* handle */ }
}
```

See docs/setup.html for the full guide.
